verdict.rationale: Netlify shows built-in event-driven automation: every push triggers a deploy and every PR gets a preview URL. Community users also mention forms/webhooks and automated builds, and the REST API and SDK are pitched for automating workflows and building custom integrations. However, there is no evidence of a user-configurable rules system that maps arbitrary events to actions. Missing for 10: documented user-defined event→action rules, event-triggered functions or outbound deploy webhooks/notifications in first-party docs, and hands-on corroboration of custom automation rules.
